podcast.title: Paul Hester as "Paul the Cook"
podcast.body: Paul Hester, former drummer of Crowded House, became a TV personality in Australia, known for playing "Paul the cook" in The Wiggles, a popular children's entertainment group. "Paul the cook was played by Paul Hester."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 2

xref.title: Paul Hester's Post-Band Career (2005)
xref.body: After the breakup, former drummer Paul Hester became a TV star in Australia, notably playing Paul the cook in The Wiggles, a children's band. "Former German Paul Hester, who had become something of a TV star in Australia. In fact, you know, if you have kids and they're into the Wiggles, Paul the cook was played by Paul Hester."
